title: 2、今年见面不收礼，收礼只收蓝白碗

content_zh:
腿上已经起了鸡皮疙瘩。
她忍不住微微蜷缩了身体。
原本就十分娇小的身体似乎也显得更加小巧了，因为楚楚冻人，似乎也变得更加的楚楚动人了。
忽然，听到了一声鸟鸣。
泉镜花不由得朝着远处看了一眼，那是一个颇为老旧的演唱会场，还是露天的那种。飞鸟飞过带来了一种荒凉破败的感觉，让人禁不住想到了倩女幽魂之中的兰若寺。
当然，镜花知道这主要还是因为天凉了，路人也少了许多。否则的话那里应该还是很热闹的。至少不应该像这样冷冷清清。
“天气越冷的话人也就会越少啊，毕竟已经老了啊！”
泉镜花心中不禁稍微有些黯然，转头朝着‘星光’走去，说到老的话，‘星光’也已经老了。
‘星光’，曾经也是全国著名的唱片公司，出过家喻户晓的唱片，不过那已经是几十年前的老黄历了。那是自己爷爷年轻时候创下的辉煌。而自己的父亲，也一直为此骄傲，总想着重现当年的辉煌。
他坚信音乐是属于天才的，只有有天赋的人才有资格玩音乐。自己没有音乐方面的才能公司才会衰败，只需要找到音乐天才就一定可以重现辉煌。
不过可惜的是他还没有找到可以带领‘星光’重返辉煌的天才，就已经去世了。
为此镜花也不禁感到遗憾，虽然她是一个重生者，不过单纯的以天赋而言，她的音乐天赋并不高，无论是歌唱还是乐器都并不拿手。如果说脑子之中记得的音乐，第一她也不是很确定，第二那些她直接拿出来也只会令人怀疑。
“如果再给我一点时间的话也许就好了。”
镜花不由得感叹着，走进了‘星光’之中。
公司之中此时也显得颇为冷清，这也是自然的。‘星光’如今已经衰败了，公司里也没有什么人，在公司的音乐总监离世之后，人心也越发的不稳。
镜花一路到了总监的办公室外，发现走廊之上还有着污迹。
“人心散了，队伍不好带了，连保洁阿姨都已经一枝红杏出墙去了。”泉镜花找来了拖把开始拖地。
不过一会儿，地板上就已经变得光洁亮丽。甚至能够从地板的反光中隐隐约约看到蓝白色的条纹。
正当泉镜花微微有些气喘停歇下来的时候，看到不远处有着一个身影。那是一个看起来有些高冷的女人，三十岁左右，戴着眼镜，穿着白领套裙的样子。
虽然神态有些高傲却并没有给人不舒服的感觉。

“难道是因为胸前的那两团压迫力太大所以才显得很自然吗？”来人堪称高风亮节，不，是高峰两截。
泉镜花不由暗暗腹诽着，口中却是问道：“姐姐你来这里有事吗？”
那个白领丽人没有说话，只是盯着泉镜花，目光仿佛凝固在了镜花身上一般。
而且，她的身体越是越发的逼近。
咚，泉镜花发现自己已经下意识的靠在了墙壁上，并且用拖把勉强护住了自己。
大危机！
泉镜花在巨大的压迫力之下，仿佛觉醒了某种莫名的感觉。
就好像有人在生与死之间，就能够看到代表死亡的线一般。
泉镜花在两团巨大的压迫力之间，也看到了一条线。
这是一条男人只要看到就会屏住呼吸的线，其名为，事业线。
虽然如今只是女儿身，但是泉镜花已经屏住了呼吸。镜花此时只感觉到自己的身体之中仿佛有一道暖流喷涌开来。面对这样的情景，见识浅薄的她着实是有些把持不住。
“可恶啊！泉镜花你真是没用啊，见到漂亮女人就心潮涌动！哼，只不过是一条区区的沟而已，看我把它推回去！可恶，如果没有这个该死的体质的话……”
泉镜花的心中狂吼着，恨不得将头埋进去。
不过，她的身体反应却十分奇怪，她的脸色越发羞红，娇艳欲滴。
而那个白领丽人仔细的审视着镜花，终于开口说话了：“这个惹人怜爱的眼神，看来你就是那个女人的女儿了。真是讨厌。”
她说起讨厌来，并没有趾高气昂的厌恶，也没有故作姿态，仿佛只是在陈述一件事情而已。
而听到她说起讨厌两个字，泉镜花才猛然惊醒。
“老……”
她刚一开口，便立刻捂住了嘴巴，拖把也因此啪的一声落在了地上。说到讨厌的话，镜花可是知道，南香绫便最是讨厌自己的母亲。

content_en:
Goosebumps already appeared on my legs.
She couldn't help but curl up slightly.
The originally very petite body seemed to be even smaller, because Chu Chu Dongren seemed to have become more charming.
Suddenly, a bird song was heard.
Izumi Kyoka couldn't help but glance in the distance. It was a rather old concert venue, open-air. The birds flying over bring a sense of desolation and ruin, which makes people think of Lanruo Temple in A Chinese Ghost Story.
Of course, Jinghua knew that this was mainly because the weather was getting cooler and there were fewer passers-by. Otherwise, it should still be very lively there. At least it shouldn't be deserted like this.
"The colder the weather, the fewer people there will be. After all, we are getting old!"
Quan Jinghua couldn't help but feel a little sad, and turned around and walked towards "Xingguang". Speaking of old, "Xingguang" was also old.
Starlight was once a well-known record company in the country and produced well-known records, but that was already decades ago. That was the glory achieved by my grandfather when he was young. And his father has always been proud of this and always wanted to recreate the glory of the past.
He firmly believes that music belongs to geniuses, and only talented people are qualified to play music. If you don't have musical talent, your company will decline. As long as you find musical talent, you will be able to regain its glory.
But it's a pity that he passed away before he could find a talent who could lead 'Starlight' back to glory.
Kyoka couldn't help but feel sorry for this. Although she was a reborn person, in terms of pure talent, her musical talent was not high, and she was not good at singing or playing musical instruments. As for the music she remembered in her mind, first of all, she wasn't very sure, and secondly, if she took it out directly, it would only be doubtful.
"Maybe it would be better if you gave me a little more time."
Jinghua couldn't help but sigh as she walked into the 'starlight'.
The company seemed quite deserted at this time, which was natural. ‘Starlight’ has now declined, and there are no people in the company. After the death of the company’s music director, people’s hearts have become increasingly unstable.
Jinghua went all the way to the outside of the director's office and found that there were stains on the corridor.
"People's hearts are broken, it's hard to lead the team, even the cleaning lady has already left a branch of red apricot out of the wall." Quan Jinghua found a mop and started mopping the floor.
After a while, the floor became smooth and bright. You can even vaguely see blue and white stripes in the reflection from the floor.
Just when Quan Jinghua stopped breathing slightly, she saw a figure not far away. It was a somewhat aloof-looking woman, about thirty years old, wearing glasses and a white-collar suit.
Although his demeanor was a little arrogant, it didn't make anyone feel uncomfortable.
"Is it because the pressure on the chest is too strong that it looks natural?" The person who came here can be said to be high-spirited and upright, no, it is two peaks.
Quan Jinghua couldn't help but secretly curse, but she asked: "Sister, are you here for anything?"
The white-collar beauty didn't speak, she just stared at Izumi Jinghua, her eyes seemed to be fixed on Jinghua.
Moreover, her body was getting closer and closer.
Boom, Quan Jinghua found that she had subconsciously leaned against the wall and barely protected herself with a mop.
Big crisis!
Under the huge pressure, Izumi Kyoka seemed to have awakened some inexplicable feeling.
It's as if someone can see the line representing death when they are between life and death.
Quan Jinghua also saw a line between the two huge groups of pressure.
This is a line that makes men hold their breath whenever they see it. Its name is career line.
Although she is only a girl now, Izumi Kyoka has held her breath. At this moment, Jinghua felt as if there was a warm current gushing out from her body.Come. Faced with such a situation, she was really unable to control herself because of her shallow knowledge.
"Damn it! Izumi Kyoka, you are so useless, your heart surges when you see a beautiful woman! Huh, it's just a ditch, watch me push it back! Damn it, if you don't have this damn physique..."
Quan Jinghua roared in her heart, wishing she could bury her head in it.
However, her body reacted very strangely, and her face became increasingly blushing and charming.
The white-collar beauty looked at Jinghua carefully and finally spoke: "With this endearing look, it seems that you are that woman's daughter. It's really annoying."
When she talked about disgust, she didn't express it in a arrogant way, nor did she make any show of it, as if she was just stating one thing.
But when she heard the word "hate" coming from her, Quan Jinghua suddenly woke up.
"Old..."
As soon as she opened her mouth, she immediately covered her mouth, causing the mop to fall to the ground with a splat. Speaking of hating, Jinghua knew that Nan Xiangling hated her mother the most.
